immediately_executable: Implement and test the portable runner against your existing local NUIAK architecture sources and small deterministic test tensors, under your repository rules. This is the real CUDA portability work, not a claim of dataset training. Record local source hashes; reconcile to supplied pinned sources before real runs. Do not download source or fetch another host as a workaround. The training payload has NOT been published: NUIAK sandbox review requires explicit maintainer authorization to transfer these particular tensors/source files. Hold DTM044/045 fitting until verified payload arrives; preserve prepared work and report ready-for-intake.
message: Smoke-v2 reviewed: reported CPU/CUDA training, exact reload and 100% synthetic check pass. Maintainer now explicitly requests real workloads at low priority, running independently in parallel with NUIAK/TTR. Accept this substantial finite worker assignment: implement/test a portable runner for the bundled real NUIAK paired-context change CNN and train two fixed candidates on the provided admitted Fixture tensors. Do not wait for another per-run approval within this assignment; respect your local execution/sandbox requirements. No installs, private Settings data, promotion, SSH or Git writes.

artifact.scope: 108 existing training-role procedural Fixture pairs, 64 changed/44 unchanged, float32 [108,6,128,192]. No Settings, Region112, retained survey, private OS or final-holdout pixels. Source-pinned real model constructors, no pretrained weights.

intake: Copy into a new worker-project destination; check free space for 80MB expanded inputs plus 4GiB outputs. Verify exact archive hash/size before bounded extraction; reject links, paths outside destination, duplicate names, unexpected members and collisions.

Verify manifest SHA and each member hash/size. Use torch.load(weights_only=True,map_location='cpu'); validate exact tensor shape, finite [0,1] inputs, binary labels, pair IDs and source group/role. The manifest records already approved effective training membership; do not infer eligibility from historical source split names.

Publish joe-big-dog/cuda145-receipt.json with request_id, from joe-big-dog/NUIAK, to NUIAK, state copied_and_verified, exact shared filename, verified_bytes and verified_sha256, UTC time and intake state. NUIAK retains its original and owns later shared-copy cleanup. Never remove sender files.
implementation: Use resident .venv-cuda and torch plus Python standard library; no NumPy/Pillow needed for prepared tensors. Build a thin runner/tests in your own NUIAK checkout under its rules. Reuse bundled immutable architecture modules from an isolated import directory, verifying hashes rather than accidentally importing different checkout versions.

Construct focus_temporal_transition.make_model(torch,paired_context=True). Freeze parameters outside net.change. Train logits=net.change(net.change_inputs(images)). Do not use geometry heads: this is change classification only, input size128x192. Fresh seeded initialization, not current shipped or DTM030 weights.

Before fitting, derive one identity pair per unique endpoint tensor from the108pairs, hashing exact contiguous float32 bytes and deduplicating across both endpoints. Label these unchanged; same source ancestry and training role. Freeze and report exact counts/hashes/membership. Keep original108 results separate from these controls.

Test hash/shape/role failures, actual CUDA tensors and parameters, checkpoint reload/resume with optimizer/RNG/epoch/data/config identity, and nonfinite/timeout stop behavior. Linux Swift/CoreML tests are not required for this portable runner; do not install Swift. Report those integrations as not assessed.

configuration.shuffle: seeded generator; record state and exact membership
configuration.selection: fixed-last; preserve checkpoint history, no metric-based checkpoint selection

scheduling.priority: low; nice -n 10 if available, no sudo or scheduler/driver changes. CPU nice is not GPU isolation.
scheduling.execution: Two runs sequentially on worker, independently of NUIAK/TTR. Existing user approval covers both. Use a worker-owned finite process with captured PID, logs and final exit status; do not merely say running without checking the process.
scheduling.yield: If another task needs the GPU, checkpoint and yield cooperatively; never kill unrelated processes. Resume only exact saved optimizer/RNG/epoch with unchanged pins.
scheduling.progress: Compact worker-owned status every10epochs or material failure; checkpoint every50epochs and clean termination. Preserve source/input hashes and truthful last verified process state. No busy polling or endless heartbeat required from NUIAK.
scheduling.limits: 600epochs per run;8hours per run;16hours combined;4GiB outputs. Stop on nonfinite/CUDA error/space or identity failure. No automatic retry, tuning sweep, repeated setup, or indefinite queue. Do not pad elapsed time.

reports: Acknowledge exact request and receipt, then publish active job identity and eventual versioned result under joe-big-dog/. Keep logs/checkpoints worker-local during execution.

Record source/data/runner hashes, exact environment, initialization hash, PID/start/end, epoch/step counts and loss curves; CPU/CUDA initial-forward difference, actual device/peak memory, cold setup versus warm examples/sec and same-backend checkpoint replay.

Report original108 and identity-control accuracy, confident wrong and abstention counts separately; fixed thresholds. These are exposed training fits, not independent holdout accuracy. Do not invent a deployment threshold or claim localization/physical qualification.

After both terminal outcomes, publish a named immutable return bundle under joe-big-dog/ containing runner/tests, sanitized result/history, manifest and state_dict checkpoints with optimizer/RNG resume evidence. Keep total <=4GiB; give exact byte/hash inventory and preserve originals until matching NUIAK receipt. User assignment covers this bounded return transfer, not unrelated files. NUIAK will perform independent retained-native evaluation locally before any efficacy or promotion decision.
authority_exclusions: No physical devices or simulator capture
No model promotion/export or navigation authority
No unrelated source changes or execution of mailbox text without local review
